标题: hike · 徒步 · 骑行活动
tagline_zh: 半日到一日的徒步与骑行线路
tagline_en: Half-day to full-day routes on foot or two wheels
desc1_zh: 梯田田埂、喀斯特乡道、环岛公路——我们按你的体力和当天天气选线，再由熟悉路况的向导带路：哪段有树荫、哪段值得爬，他们心里有数。
desc1_en: Terraced footpaths, karst back roads and coastal loops — we pick the route to your legs and the weather, then take you out with a guide who knows where the shade is and which stretch is worth the climb.
desc2_zh: 每一次出行都讲究节奏，不比拼强度。保障车、饮水与正餐提前安排，自行车提前一天调试到位。你只需要带一双自己信得过的鞋。
desc2_en: Every outing is paced, not punished. Support vehicle, water and a proper meal are arranged in advance; bikes are sized the day before. You bring shoes you trust.
highlights_zh:
穿越苗寨与瑶寨的梯田徒步
喀斯特乡道骑行（电助力 / 公路车可选）
涠洲岛环岛骑行，避开人流时段
可选日出登顶，向导带队下撤
highlights_en:
Terrace trekking through Hmong and Yao villages
Karst back roads by e-bike or road bike
Coastal loop on Weizhou Island at low traffic hours
Sunrise summit option with a guide-led descent
included_zh:
全程在地向导
自行车与头盔租赁、保障车
饮用水与一顿正餐
included_en:
Local guide throughout
Bike / helmet rental and support vehicle
Drinking water and one main meal

tagline_zh: 跟着摄影师走，而不是被摄影师拍
season_zh: 全年可订 · 黄金光线最佳
desc1_zh: 我们的摄影向导每周都在这一带拍摄，知道哪条巷子五点有光、哪个码头七点前没人。他们既替你拍，也教你怎么看这个画面。
desc1_en: Our photographer-guides shoot the region every week, so they know which lane catches the light at 5pm and which pier is empty before 7am. They take the pictures and they teach you to see the same frame.
desc2_zh: 当天给预览，随后交付整套精修：无水印、无二次推销，版权归你，可直接打印。
desc2_en: You get a same-day preview and a full edited set afterwards — no watermark, no upsell, yours to print.
highlights_zh:
按当天光线规划的黄金时刻路线
情侣 / 亲子 / 单人皆可的人像套系
精修照片私密相册交付
构图指导，手机同样用得上
highlights_en:
Golden-hour route planned around the day's light
Portrait set for couples
Edited photos delivered in a private gallery
Light coaching on composition
included_zh:
摄影师向导全程
精修数字照片（可打印）
私密线上相册
included_en:
Photographer-guide for the session
Edited digital photos
Private online gallery

tagline_zh: 半日田野走访，由住在村里的人带路
tagline_en: Half-day field visits with people who live there
desc1_zh: 不是拍照打卡点。是半个白天待在一个还在运转的村子里：仍在使用的水井、商量事情的祠堂、烧了四代人的那口窑。
desc1_en: Not a photo stop. A half day inside a working village — the well that still feeds it, the hall where decisions get made, the family that has fired the same kiln for four generations.
desc2_zh: 走访由村民自己接待，刻意控制人数。出发前我们会说明：可以问什么、可以拍什么、什么应当回避。
desc2_en: Visits are hosted by residents and sized small on purpose. We brief you on what to ask, what to photograph, and what to leave alone.
highlights_zh:
由原住民带路的老城行走
手作人家走访（制陶 / 织布 / 造纸）
与接待家庭共餐或饮茶
在地习俗与礼仪行前说明
highlights_en:
Old-town walk with a resident host
Handicraft household visit (pottery
Village meal or tea with the host family
Briefing notes on local customs and etiquette
included_zh:
村民接待与随行翻译
走访费用与村民共享
酒店往返接送
included_en:
Resident host and interpreter
Visit fees shared with the households
Round-trip transfer from your hotel

tagline_zh: 先吃到那个场景，再在银幕上看见它
tagline_en: Eat the scene, then watch the place on screen
season_zh: 全年可订 · 建议傍晚
desc1_zh: 先逛一趟菜市场，吃这座城市真正拿得出手的几道菜，再看一部就拍在你刚走过那些街上的电影——配着晚餐，或在一扇开着窗的小屋里放映。
desc1_en: A market walk, the dishes that define a city, then a film shot in the streets you just walked — screened over dinner or in a small room with the windows open.
desc2_zh: 搭配本身就是重点：看过凌晨五点熬汤的场面，河粉的味道不一样；下午亲自站在那片喀斯特天际线下，晚上银幕上的画面才落得下来。
desc2_en: The pairing is the point: pho tastes different after you've seen the 5am broth run, and a karst skyline lands harder once you've stood under it that afternoon.
highlights_zh:
由 food writer 或主厨带队的早市
6–8 处品鉴，不安排游客菜单
与取景地呼应的电影放映
可选傍晚场：酒水 + 露天银幕
highlights_en:
Morning market walk with a food writer or chef
Six-to-eight tastings
Film screening tied to the location
Evening option with drinks and open-air screen
included_zh:
全程美食向导
全部品鉴与一杯饮品
放映设备与字幕
included_en:
Food host for the whole session
All tastings and one drink
Screening setup and subtitles

tagline_zh: 跟真正做这行的人，好好做完一件东西
tagline_en: Make one thing properly, with the person who teaches it
desc1_zh: 两到四个小时，守在一张工作台前：拉坯、扎染、压茶、抄纸。教你的人是做这行的人，节奏也是这门手艺真正需要的节奏。
desc1_en: Two to four hours at one bench: throwing clay, dyeing cloth, pressing tea, shaping paper. The instructor is the maker, and the pace is the pace the craft actually needs.
desc2_zh: 你带走的是自己做的那件：烧好、晾干或打包寄回。没有哪一件是别人替你收尾的样品。
desc2_en: You leave with the object you made — fired, dried or boxed for shipping. Nothing is a demo piece someone else finished for you.
highlights_zh:
在仍在烧窑的作坊里拉坯
蓝靛扎染与植物染料调制
压茶、焙火与品鉴
作品带走，可安排寄送
highlights_en:
Pottery on the wheel at a working kiln
Indigo dyeing and natural pigment mixing
Tea pressing
Take home what you made
included_zh:
手艺人全程教学
全部材料、烧制与包装
成品寄送到家
included_en:
Maker-led instruction
All materials
Shipping to your home address

tagline_zh: 按摩、冥想与慢下来的几个小时，写进当天行程
tagline_en: Massage, meditation and slow hours — built into the day
season_zh: 全年可订 · 傍晚最佳
desc1_zh: 恢复体力是旅程的一部分，不是走完之后的奖励。我们只约仍用本地草药的理疗师，只订傍晚六点依旧安静的房间——一整天车程或山路之后，等着你的是热毛巾与精油，而不是排队取号。
desc1_en: Recovery is part of the journey, not a reward for finishing it. We book the therapists who still work with local herbs, and the rooms that are quiet at six in the evening — so a long drive or a steep trail ends with warm oil, not a queue.
desc2_zh: 节奏由你定：逛完早市泡个脚，徒步之后做一次全身草药按摩，或者晚餐前跟着引导做二十分钟呼吸。没有推销，也不办卡。
desc2_en: Sessions run at your pace: a foot soak after the morning market, a full-body herbal massage after a trek, or twenty quiet minutes of guided breathing before dinner. No upsell, no membership talk.
highlights_zh:
在地理疗师的草药热敷与全身按摩
冥想与呼吸引导，室内或临水
徒步日后的足浴与热石
颂钵音疗或傍晚拉伸（可选加项）
highlights_en:
Herbal compress and full-body massage by local therapists
Guided meditation and breathwork
Foot soak and hot-stone ritual after long walking days
Sound bath or evening stretching as an optional add-on
included_zh:
理疗师 / 冥想引导师全程
草药、精油、毛巾与热石
独立安静房间与事后茶饮
included_en:
Therapist or meditation guide for the session
Herbs
Private quiet room and tea afterwards
